description: This file defines the ErrorRule class in the Aws\EndpointV2\Rule namespace, responsible for evaluating error conditions and potentially throwing exceptions within the AWS SDK's endpoint resolution process.

classes.name: ErrorRule
classes.description: Represents a rule that detects and handles specific error scenarios during endpoint resolution in the AWS SDK; extends AbstractRule and throws UnresolvedEndpointException upon condition fulfillment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorRule with a definition array, storing the error information.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error details associated with this rule.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the rule's conditions against input parameters; if conditions are met, throws an UnresolvedEndpointException with a resolved error message.
